site.title: CrabBridge — Codex ↔ DeepSeek / Kimi
site.description: Lightweight Rust proxy that lets Codex CLI talk to DeepSeek or Kimi Code through the OpenAI Responses API. Keys stay in your environment — never in config.

hero.subtitle: Rust proxy for the OpenAI Responses API. One process, multiple providers. Keys never touch crabbridge.toml.
hero.meta: Rust · local :11435 · Responses API · SQLite sessions · MIT

bridge.title: Responses API bridge
bridge.desc: Accepts Codex Responses requests, translates to upstream Chat Completions — including streaming SSE.

multi_provider.title: Multi-provider routes
multi_provider.desc: One process hosts DeepSeek and Kimi. Pick by path: /deepseek/v1 or /kimi/v1.

keys_safe.title: Keys stay out of config
keys_safe.desc: API keys arrive as Bearer tokens from Codex env_key. Never stored in crabbridge.toml.

desktop.title: Desktop + CLI
desktop.desc: Tray app auto-starts the bridge; Setup Wizard wires ~/.codex/config.toml in one click.

responses.title: Codex-native wire
responses.desc: wire_api = "responses". Point Codex at the bridge — no Chat Completions shim on the client side.

streaming.title: Streaming SSE
streaming.desc: Upstream streams stay streamed. Low-friction agent loops, not buffered blobs.

sessions.title: SQLite sessions
sessions.desc: Multi-turn state persists locally so bridge restarts don't wipe context.

routing.title: Path-based providers
routing.desc: Switch models by changing model_provider — same host, different /{provider}/v1 base URL.

ops.title: Health & metrics
ops.desc: /health, /admin dashboard, and Prometheus /metrics for a peek under the shell.

step1.title: Install
step1.desc: Install the crabridge binary (macOS / Linux / Windows scripts upstream).

step2.title: Configure Codex
step2.desc: Export your API keys, then point Codex at the bridge (or use the desktop Setup Wizard).
step2.config:
model_provider = "crabbridge-deepseek"
model = "deepseek-v4-pro"

[model_providers.crabbridge-deepseek]
name = "crabbridge-deepseek"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:11435/deepseek/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
env_key = "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"

[model_providers.crabbridge-kimi]
name = "crabbridge-kimi"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:11435/kimi/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
env_key = "KIMI_API_KEY"

bridge_preview.title: Desktop app
bridge_preview.caption: Start / stop the bridge, open Admin, and run Setup Wizard — keys stay in your environment or keychain.
bridge_preview.alt: CrabBridge desktop app in dark mode: running status, Start Bridge / Stop / Admin, Current setup for DeepSeek, and ready checklist
